items: P2.1 (second retained unit: arrival-aware solo batch dispatch)
title: Solo generation dispatch without the full batch window retained

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

change.summary: _GenerationBatcher._run pays the generation batch window only when it can help: a solo queued submission on an idle engine dispatches after one 2 ms slice; two or more queued submissions or a busy engine still honor the full window, so concurrent-arrival batching is unchanged.

control_measurement.note: Before the change, the frozen protocol's 50 ms window was paid in full by every solo request; a --batch-window-ms 0 control isolated the cost.
control_measurement.command: frozen prefill arm, widths 1,2, batch-window 0 vs 50 (post low-M owner band)

server_prefill_frozen_protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python3 scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --quant Q4_K_M --execution-profile production --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --widths 1,2,4 --max-tokens 1 --candidate-budget 3 --batch-window-ms 50 --max-sequence-length 1024 --expected-mtp-widths '' --correctness-contract ar_exact
server_prefill_frozen_protocol.correctness: every cell ar_self_exact / mtp_self_exact / ar_mtp_equal passed

gates.red: tests/test_server_api.py::test_generation_batcher_dispatches_solo_submission_before_full_window failed at 0.101 s elapsed before the change, passes after (dispatch slice 2 ms)
gates.full_suite: only the 3 pre-existing test_specdec2_perf_bridge ordering flakes; compileall, check_fixtures, smoke registry, smoke cpu-fixtures OK

residual C1 host/route overhead ~65 ms (scheduler tick, reclaim/events, one-token decode, API boundary)
